purpose: docs/weeks/week-06.md exit criterion, clause 1 — the label-path column

fixed.P_note: official organizers' checkpoint, reproduces published F1 to +-0.0001

design.pooling: counts summed, compute_metrics applied once (never averaged ratios)
design.cell: top-right against top-left of plan section 1's 2x2: label-path corruption alone, model unimpaired. The input-path row needs the text-dependent arm and is weeks 7-9, so only the scoring column exists here.

c_gold.dagger_alef_rule: delete (54/98 phoneme_exact, vs 48/98 for U+0670 -> alef)

leg_b_anchor.note: The gap is our phonetizer's disagreement with the uploader's (44/98 prompts, tajwid conventions), reported separately so it is not inside any dF1. Belongs in the limitations.

predictions_registered.1: dF1 is negative and the mechanism is FA inflation
predictions_registered.2: |dF1| is monotone in CE DER: catt-eo < catt-ed < shakkala < mishkal
predictions_registered.3: the case-ending share of label damage is high on this arm — a caveat, not a finding; Qur'anic recitation pronounces case endings, so plan section 1's MSA pausal argument does not transfer. Measured at text level only; see results.*.case_ending_share.phoneme_level

clause_1.criteria: CI excludes zero for at least the worst diacritizer, and the per-tool point estimates are monotone in DER. Two-sided: plan section 1 says nobody knows the sign.

case_ending_share.phoneme_level_note: not measured: needs word boundaries inside the phoneme sequence, and per-word phonetization diverges from whole-utterance phonetization (section 4.1.1). Deferred rather than approximated.

attribution.corrupted_sites_unit: canonical disagreement positions x clips reading that prompt
attribution.note: A ratio <= 1 means label corruption is transmitted, not amplified, by three-way Needleman-Wunsch. A nonzero delta on a prompt whose C_auto equals C_gold would be a pure alignment artifact. Diagnostic for the gate only -- not plan section 4.2's corruption-attributable FR rate, which is a weeks-10-12 deliverable.
